text:
mei: FYI, nightly int8 bring-up for orion-v3 showed deterministic token reordering when ZWJ/narrow-space occurs between CJK ideographs and fullwidth numbers. Repro on vertical/ja and vertical/zh samples.
mei: Sample snapshot (raw bytes escaped): '\u660e\u200d\u5e741' expected detok -> '\u660e\u200d\u5e741' but int8 detok became '1\u660e\u200d\u5e74'.
mei: Quick run we used:
```bash
./eval_local.sh --model orion-v3-int8 --locale ja-vertical --samples tests/vertical_furigana/003.json --mode detok_compare
```
mei: Dashboard spike: https://console.redwood.com/evals/73621 (BLEU and WER diffs)
tian: could be tokenizer or generation ordering. can you run tokenizer-only detok?
mei: tokenizer-only detok OK on my dev box (matches fp16). So appears during generation / kvcache emission.
alex: did we change export pretokenize last week? commit 9a7b3e3 touched that path. Could be subtle reindexing.
sophia: starting triage: triage-bot, bisect export pipeline 9a7b3e3..HEAD for orion-v3-int8 on p4d nodes (driver 525).
triage-bot: bisect started over 14 commits, will update with first failing commit.
mei: attached FP16 vs INT8 generation traces (short):
```
FP16: [<BOS>, \u660e, \u200d, \u5e74, 1, <EOS>] -> detok '\u660e\u200d\u5e741'
INT8: [<BOS>, 1, \u660e, \u200d, \u5e74, <EOS>] -> detok '1\u660e\u200d\u5e74'
```
mei: ordering flips so token 1 emitted early under int8 fused attention path.
tian: matches previous flaky attention-kv write we saw on driver 525. triage-bot note GPU driver variant.
triage-bot: bisect update: first failing commit 9a7b3e3. Repro only when using int8 export path + driver 525.* on p4d.
sophia: propose immediate mitigation: add locale-aware post-detok pass that reinserts ZWJ/narrowspace between CJK ideograph and following ascii digit/fullwidth number if original input had it. Low-risk and reversible.
alex: agree. Also add unit tests exercising vertical/ja and vertical/zh failing samples.
mei: I'll open a runtime PR with tests and a feature flag to enable the temporary fix per-deployment.
tian: also add nightly CI job to run detok parity for our small set of vertical/furigana/ZWJ samples on int8 so we catch regressions.
sophia: draft PR #4321 created, added smoke tests and sample artifacts, tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for review.
triage-bot: bisect completed; root cause metadata written to ticket INF-1289.
mei: leaving thread open until runtime patch lands and CI green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
